info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Create Payment Rail Operation Operational Action-spec
info.description: The Payment Rail Operations API facilitates the creation of operational actions related to payment rail transactions. This API enables businesses to initiate and manage various payment processes efficiently, ensuring seamless financial operations. Typical consumers include payment service providers, financial institutions, and fintech applications that require automated payment handling. With robust endpoints for operational action creation, this API simplifies complex payment workflows and enhances transaction reliability.

post.summary: Create a new operational action for payment rail operations.
post.description: This endpoint allows users to initiate a new operational action within the payment rail system. By providing the necessary details in the request, you can create and manage operational actions to optimize payment processing effectively.
